name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Shawarma with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
description: Warm-spiced chicken thighs and cauliflower roasted on one pan, served with rice or warm pita, cucumbers, and a quick garlic yogurt sauce. The new one this week — mild enough for the kids, with the sauce doing double duty as a dip.
ingredients: 1 lemon (juice of half; rest in wedges)
4 garlic cloves, minced (3 for chicken, 1 for sauce)
1 cucumber, sliced (half grated for the sauce if you like)
Jasmine rice or warm pita, to serve
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F. In a bowl, mix 2 Tbsp oil, lemon juice, 3 garlic cloves, all the spices, and 1 tsp salt. Toss the chicken in it (up to 8 hours ahead, in the fridge).
Toss the cauliflower and onion with the remaining oil and 1/2 tsp salt. Spread on a large sheet pan with the chicken in a single layer.
Roast 25–30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 175°F and the cauliflower is browned at the edges. Broil 2 minutes for extra char if you want.
Meanwhile, stir the yogurt with the last garlic clove, a squeeze of lemon, a pinch of salt, and a little grated cucumber.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice or in pita with cauliflower, cucumbers, and the yogurt sauce.
tips: Marinating in the morning makes dinner a 5-minute assembly.
Thighs stay juicy even if they go a few minutes over — better than breasts here.
For the kids, serve deconstructed: chicken strips, rice, cucumbers, and yogurt to dip.
Leftovers make a great lunch bowl.
